depictions.name: Gion Shrine
depictions.text: Yasaka Shrine (八坂神社), formerly known as Gion Shrine, is a Shinto shrine in the Gion district of Kyoto, Japan. During the Sengoku period, it was situated on the eastern outskirts of the city, within the Hills of Meeting. In 1582, the Kakushiba ikki members Fujibayashi Naoe and Yasuke visited the site and paid their respects at two of its smaller shrines.
